component.name: Co-Writer
component.summary: Local research and writing companion with Documancy

description.p: Co-Writer is a local research and writing companion. Its Documancy tools open, edit, reformat, recover, and export documents.

ul.li: Multi-tab editor with markdown formatting toolbar
File browser sidebar with workspace management
Adaptive panes with show/hide controls; the AI pane hides first on smaller windows
Zettelkasten notebook with wikilinks and backlinks
AI-powered document recovery for corrupt files
Ollama integration for editing, drafting, and rewriting
Evidence audits with claim classification and scholarly sources from Europe PMC
Import from 9 formats including EPUB and MOBI
Export to 6 formats including PDF, DOCX, and ODT

description.p: Co-Writer v4 adds Documancy, multi-tab editing, a file browser, notebook tools, markdown formatting, document recovery, model auto-detection, and comprehensive import/export. Adaptive panes keep the editor usable in smaller windows, with header controls to show or hide Files/Notebook and the AI assistant.
